## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive (Energy, Communication, Technology). Confirmations: low sector breadth and mixed internals across large caps, plus broad top-performer mix; Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5).

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Energy lead: XOM (1W: +1.49% | 1M: +5.59%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +3.12% | 1M: +7.70%) ABOVE TREND, PSX (1W: +9.17% | 1M: +13.32%) ABOVE TREND. Communication strong: NFLX (1W: +17.24% | 1M: +24.06%) ABOVE TREND. Technology showing selective strength: INTU (1W: +18.35% | 1M: +7.53%) ABOVE TREND, ADBE (1W: +8.76% | 1M: +3.61%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Consumer Staples weak: PM (1W: -9.49% | 1M: -4.12%) BELOW TREND, EL (1W: -14.06% | 1M: -17.29%) BELOW TREND. Materials weakness: PPG (1W: -9.40% | 1M: -5.86%) BELOW TREND, NEM (1W: -8.74% | 1M: -0.70%) BELOW TREND. Financials soft: GS (1W: -9.60% | 1M: -10.56%) BELOW TREND, JPM (1W: -4.11% | 1M: -6.77%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: INTU (1W: +18.35% | 1M: +7.53%) ABOVE TREND, NFLX (1W: +17.24% | 1M: +24.06%) ABOVE TREND, DOW (1W: +14.11% | 1M: +11.90%) ABOVE TREND, PLTR (1W: +12.31% | 1M: -3.30%) RECOVERY, VLO (1W: +11.89% | 1M: +19.32%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5); style: mixed / no clear leadership.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: F (1W: -14.37% | 1M: -9.15%) BELOW TREND, EL (1W: -14.06% | 1M: -17.29%) BELOW TREND, MNST (1W: -11.49% | 1M: -6.43%) BELOW TREND, RCL (1W: -11.25% | 1M: -13.25%) BELOW TREND, UPS (1W: -10.77% | 1M: -5.66%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in consumer discretionary/consumer staples and select industrials.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Strongest 1W movers: INTU (1W: +18.35% | 1M: +7.53%) ABOVE TREND, NFLX (1W: +17.24% | 1M: +24.06%) ABOVE TREND, DOW (1W: +14.11% | 1M: +11.90%) ABOVE TREND; watch PLTR (1W: +12.31% | 1M: -3.30%) RECOVERY and PANW (1W: +9.21% | 1M: -1.85%) RECOVERY as tactical momentum. Major divergence present (≥3 large names with 1W ≠ 1M) — watch for trend breaks.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Tech mixed but showing pockets of strength; AAPL (1W: -4.64% | 1M: -3.32%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: +2.23% | 1M: +0.10%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: -0.84% | 1M: +1.66%) CORRECTION, INTU (1W: +18.35% | 1M: +7.53%) ABOVE TREND. Sector breadth: Technology is one of the three positive sectors within a low overall breadth environment.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Financials remain under pressure with uneven internals; GS (1W: -9.60% | 1M: -10.56%) BELOW TREND, JPM (1W: -4.11% | 1M: -6.77%) BELOW TREND, V (1W: +0.98% | 1M: -2.58%) RECOVERY. Sector breadth: Financials negative and contributing to the neutral market posture; style: value/cyclical not broadly leading.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Healthcare mixed/defensive tone but not leadership: UNH (1W: +0.74% | 1M: +1.62%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: -1.58% | 1M: +3.35%) CORRECTION, LLY (1W: -3.79% | 1M: -1.85%) BELOW TREND. Sector breadth: Healthcare slightly negative on 1W but still showing pockets of strength and several bullish news catalysts.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor selective exposure to Energy and high-conviction Tech names showing ABOVE TREND (e.g., PSX (1W: +9.17% | 1M: +13.32%) ABOVE TREND, INTU (1W: +18.35% | 1M: +7.53%) ABOVE TREND) and reduce exposure to exposed Financials and weak consumer staples (GS, PM, EL). Given NEUTRAL regime and major divergences, stay selective and monitor recovery names for confirmation.

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: INTU (1W: +18.35% | 1M: +7.53%) ABOVE TREND, PSX (1W: +9.17% | 1M: +13.32%) ABOVE TREND, NFLX (1W: +17.24% | 1M: +24.06%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: GS (1W: -9.60% | 1M: -10.56%) BELOW TREND, PM (1W: -9.49% | 1M: -4.12%) BELOW TREND, GOOGL (1W: -2.11% | 1M: -11.43%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Energy (1W: +4.31% | 1M: +11.59%) — watch continued follow-through among refiners and majors. BEARISH: Consumer Staples and Materials (1W: -4.72% and -4.04% respectively) — watch earnings/sentiment flow and continued downside in staples names.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
NVDA (1W: -0.84% | 1M: +1.66%) CORRECTION — a failure to hold the current 1M gains on a weekly close would signal further downside. AAPL (1W: -4.64% | 1M: -3.32%) BELOW TREND — watch for follow-through below recent weekly lows as confirmation of extended weakness. GS (1W: -9.60% | 1M: -10.56%) BELOW TREND — renewed selling on poor tape would signal further financial sector stress.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
PSX (+55): Analyst upgrades and dividend chatter; PSX (1W: +9.17% | 1M: +13.32%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirming price action. PEP (+60): Snack price cuts and buyback headlines; PEP (1W: not in top/bottom snapshot | 1M: not in snapshot) — positive sentiment to monitor for confirmation in price. CSCO (+60): Large AI networking orders headline; CSCO (1W: not in top/bottom snapshot | 1M: not in snapshot) — watch for price follow-through versus prolonged distribution.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
PM (-70): Earnings miss headline matches price action — PM (1W: -9.49% | 1M: -4.12%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirmed. MNST (-55): Weak Q4 reaction aligned with price — MNST (1W: -11.49% | 1M: -6.43%) BELOW TREND and sentiment confirming. NVDA (-50): H200 production pause headline vs NVDA (1W: -0.84% | 1M: +1.66%) CORRECTION — sentiment diverging from modest 1M gains, watch for distribution.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL regime, style mixed / no clear leadership. PSX (1W: +9.17% | 1M: +13.32%) ABOVE TREND and INTU (1W: +18.35% | 1M: +7.53%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk: major divergence across large caps (multiple RECOVERY/CORRECTION signals) and bearish sentiment in staples (PM) could produce trend breaks — monitor for confirmation.
